recipes.title: Sazerac
recipes.description: A New Orleans classic with rye, bitters, and an aromatic absinthe rinse.
steps: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and discard the excess.
Stir rye, sugar, bitters, water, and ice until cold; strain into the glass and express lemon peel over it.

recipes.title: Clover Club
recipes.description: Gin, raspberry, lemon, and a silky optional egg-white foam.
steps: Shake all ingredients without ice first if using egg white.
Add ice, shake until chilled, and strain into a coupe.

recipes.title: Bramble
recipes.description: A gin and lemon sour finished with blackberry liqueur.
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice, syrup, and ice; strain over crushed ice.
Drizzle blackberry liqueur over the top and garnish with berries.

recipes.title: Bee's Knees
recipes.description: A Prohibition-era gin sour sweetened with honey and brightened with lemon.
steps: Shake gin, lemon juice, honey syrup, and ice until chilled.
Strain into a coupe and garnish with lemon.

recipes.title: Paper Plane
recipes.description: A balanced modern sour with bourbon, bitter orange, amaro, and lemon.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a coupe and garnish with lemon peel.

recipes.title: Penicillin
recipes.description: Scotch, lemon, honey-ginger, and a smoky whisky float.
steps: Shake blended Scotch, lemon, honey-ginger syrup, and ice.
Strain over fresh ice and float the smoky Scotch on top.

recipes.title: Boulevardier
recipes.description: A whiskey-led bitter aperitif with Campari and sweet vermouth.
steps: Stir bourbon, Campari, vermouth, and ice until chilled.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish with orange peel.

recipes.title: Vesper
recipes.description: A crisp gin and vodka martini with aromatized wine.
steps: Shake gin, vodka, Lillet Blanc, and ice until very cold.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with lemon.

recipes.title: Gimlet
recipes.description: A brisk gin cocktail balanced with lime cordial.
steps: Shake gin, lime cordial, lime juice, and ice until chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with lime.

recipes.title: Corpse Reviver No. 2
recipes.description: A bright equal-parts gin cocktail with citrus and a touch of absinthe.
steps: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe and discard excess.
Shake gin, orange liqueur, Lillet, lemon, and ice; strain into the glass.

recipes.title: Aperol Spritz
recipes.description: A sparkling aperitif with orange bittersweetness.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add prosecco, Aperol, and soda; stir gently and garnish with orange.

recipes.title: Paloma
recipes.description: Tequila and grapefruit with lime and sparkling soda.
steps: Salt half the rim of a glass if desired and fill it with ice.
Add tequila and juices, top with sparkling water, and stir.

recipes.title: Jungle Bird
recipes.description: A tropical rum cocktail with pineapple, lime, and a bitter Campari edge.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish with pineapple.

recipes.title: Singapore Sling
recipes.description: A fruity gin highball with cherry liqueur, citrus, and soda.
steps: Shake gin, liqueurs, pineapple, lime, bitters, and ice.
Strain into an ice-filled glass, top with soda, and stir gently.

recipes.title: French 75
recipes.description: Gin, lemon, and sparkling wine in a bright celebratory cocktail.
steps: Shake gin, lemon, syrup, and ice until chilled.
Strain into a flute and top with sparkling wine.

recipes.title: Mai Tai
recipes.description: A layered rum cocktail with lime and almond-orange notes.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Pour into a rocks glass and garnish with mint and lime.

recipes.title: Tom Collins
recipes.description: Gin lengthened with lemon, soda, and a little sweetness.
steps: Shake gin, lemon, syrup, and ice.
Strain into an ice-filled glass, top with soda, and stir gently.

recipes.title: Dark and Stormy
recipes.description: Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer and lime.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice and add ginger beer and lime.
Float rum over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Sidecar
recipes.description: A classic brandy sour with orange liqueur and lemon.
steps: Sugar the rim of a chilled coupe if desired.
Shake cognac, orange liqueur, lemon, and ice; strain into the glass.

recipes.title: Mint Julep
recipes.description: Bourbon, mint, and sugar served over crushed ice.
steps: Gently press mint with sugar and water in a julep cup.
Pack with crushed ice, add bourbon, and stir until frosty.

recipes.title: Bloody Mary
recipes.description: A savory tomato cocktail seasoned with lemon and spice.
steps: Add all ingredients to an ice-filled glass.
Roll between two glasses to mix and garnish with celery.

recipes.title: Bellini
recipes.description: Peach puree topped with chilled sparkling wine.
steps: Pour peach puree into a chilled flute.
Slowly top with prosecco and stir once.

recipes.title: Mimosa
recipes.description: A brunch classic made with sparkling wine and orange juice.
steps: Pour orange juice into a flute.
Top slowly with prosecco and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Caipirinha
recipes.description: Brazilian cachaça muddled with lime and sugar.
steps: Muddle lime wedges with sugar in a rocks glass.
Fill with crushed ice, add cachaça, and stir well.

recipes.title: Aviation
recipes.description: A floral gin cocktail with lemon and maraschino liqueur.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice until cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a cherry.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Chicken Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Quick chicken and rice bowls with lemon, cucumber, and herbs.
steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and half the lemon; sear in oil until cooked through.
Serve over rice with cucumber, parsley, and remaining lemon.

recipes.title: Salmon Avocado Rice Bowl
recipes.description: A fast salmon bowl with avocado, rice, and lime.
steps: Season salmon and pan-sear in oil until opaque and flaky.
Serve over rice with avocado and lime.

recipes.title: Shrimp Taco Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Chili-lime shrimp tucked into crisp lettuce with salsa.
steps: Toss shrimp with chili powder, salt, and lime; sear in oil until pink.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with salsa.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Skillet
recipes.description: A one-pan turkey and bean taco filling served with avocado.
steps: Brown turkey and pepper in oil, then stir in taco seasoning.
Add beans and water; simmer until thick and serve with avocado.

recipes.title: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
recipes.description: A quick coconut curry with chickpeas and tender spinach.
steps: Soften onion in oil and stir in curry powder.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 10 minutes, fold in spinach, and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Caprese Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: Quinoa with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, and balsamic.
steps: Simmer quinoa in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Cool briefly and toss with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, oil, and balsamic.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli with Tamari
recipes.description: Tender beef and broccoli in a quick gluten-free tamari sauce.
steps: Sear beef in hot oil and transfer to a plate.
Stir-fry broccoli; add tamari, honey, ginger, and beef, then serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: Chicken and zucchini ribbons tossed with basil pesto.
steps: Season and cook chicken in oil until golden and cooked through.
Add zucchini noodles for 2 minutes, toss with pesto, and finish with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky sweet potato and black beans in warm corn tortillas.
steps: Microwave sweet potato with a splash of water until just tender, then crisp in oil with paprika.
Add black beans and heat through; serve in warm corn tortillas with lime and salsa.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A filling salad of chicken, cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta.
steps: Season and pan-cook chicken until done; rest and slice.
Toss vegetables, olives, feta, oil, and lemon; top with chicken.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice with Peas
recipes.description: A quick skillet rice with egg, peas, and gluten-free tamari.
steps: Scramble eggs in sesame oil and set aside.
Stir-fry rice and peas, add tamari and scallions, then fold in eggs.

recipes.title: Tuna Cucumber Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Pantry-friendly tuna bowls with crisp cucumber and rice.
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and tamari.
Serve over rice with cucumber, sesame seeds, and lime.

recipes.title: Sausage and Pepper Skillet
recipes.description: Smoky sausage with sweet peppers for a fast one-pan dinner.
ingredients: 300 g certified gluten-free smoked sausage, sliced
steps: Brown sausage in a skillet and set aside.
Cook peppers and onion until tender; return sausage, add paprika, and heat through.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pepper Skillet
recipes.description: All the flavors of stuffed peppers in a quick rice skillet.
steps: Brown beef and peppers in oil; drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in tomatoes, rice, and seasoning; simmer 8 minutes and top with cheddar.

recipes.title: Tomato Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A speedy red lentil soup with tomato, cumin, and lemon.
steps: Soften onion in oil and stir in cumin.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth; simmer until lentils are soft, then finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Coconut Lime Chicken Soup
recipes.description: A light chicken soup with coconut milk, lime, and ginger.
steps: Bring coconut milk and broth to a simmer with ginger and mushrooms.
Add chicken and cook through; season with fish sauce and lime.

recipes.title: Steak Chimichurri Salad
recipes.description: Sliced steak over greens with a fresh parsley chimichurri.
steps: Season steak and sear to desired doneness; rest before slicing.
Chop parsley and garlic, mix with oil and vinegar, then serve over greens with steak.

recipes.title: Peanut Rice Noodles with Tofu
recipes.description: Rice noodles and tofu coated in a quick lime-peanut sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to the package and pan-crisp tofu in oil.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, honey, and a splash of water; toss with noodles and tofu.

recipes.title: Mediterranean White Bean Skillet
recipes.description: White beans simmered with tomatoes, olives, and spinach.
steps: Sizzle garlic in olive oil and add tomatoes until they begin to soften.
Stir in beans and olives; warm through, fold in spinach, and finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Spinach and Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.description: Crisp potatoes and spinach topped with eggs.
steps: Microwave potatoes until nearly tender, then crisp in oil with paprika.
Fold in spinach; make wells, add eggs, cover, and cook until set.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Power Bowl
recipes.description: A colorful bowl of sweet potato, black beans, avocado, and lime.
steps: Microwave sweet potato until tender, then toss with oil and cumin in a hot pan to brown.
Build bowls with quinoa, beans, sweet potato, avocado, and lime.

recipes.title: Turkey Avocado Lettuce Cups
recipes.description: Cool lettuce cups filled with turkey, avocado, and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Mix turkey with mayonnaise, Dijon, and lemon.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with avocado and carrot.

recipes.title: Baked Feta Tomato Chickpeas
recipes.description: Warm chickpeas and tomatoes with baked feta and herbs.
steps: Add chickpeas and tomatoes to a small baking dish, drizzle with oil, and place feta in the center.
Bake at 220°C until tomatoes burst and feta softens; finish with oregano and basil.

recipes.title: Chicken Cauliflower Fried Rice
recipes.description: A lighter fried rice with chicken, egg, vegetables, and cauliflower rice.
steps: Cook chicken in sesame oil until browned and cooked through; push to one side and scramble egg.
Add vegetables and cauliflower rice, stir-fry until hot, then season with tamari.

recipes.title: Zucchini Corn Fritters
recipes.description: Golden zucchini and corn fritters bound with almond flour.
steps: Mix zucchini, corn, eggs, almond flour, chives, and salt.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil until golden on both sides; serve with plain yogurt.

recipes.title: Mushroom Spinach Omelet
recipes.description: A soft omelet filled with buttery mushrooms and fresh spinach.
steps: Cook mushrooms in butter until browned; add spinach until wilted.
Pour in beaten eggs, cook until nearly set, add cheddar, and fold.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.description: Quick blender pancakes made with banana and certified gluten-free oats.
steps: Blend banana, oats, eggs, baking powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook small pancakes in butter over medium heat until set on both sides.

recipes.title: Berry Chia Yogurt Bowl
recipes.description: Creamy yogurt with berries, chia, and a little honey.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl and top with berries and chia.
Drizzle with honey and add almonds.

recipes.title: Quick Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Cook pepper in oil until soft; add tomatoes, cumin, and paprika and simmer 8 minutes.
Make wells, add eggs, cover, and cook until whites are set; garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Plate
recipes.description: A no-cook plate of smoked salmon, cucumber, dill, and cream cheese.
steps: Stir dill and black pepper into cream cheese.
Arrange with salmon and cucumber; squeeze lemon over the plate.

recipes.title: Crispy Chickpea Chopped Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy chickpeas over chopped vegetables with lemon dressing.
steps: Season chickpeas with paprika and roast or air-fry until crisp.
Toss lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes with oil and lemon; top with chickpeas.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Polenta
recipes.description: Quick shrimp over creamy instant polenta with lemon and parsley.
steps: Cook polenta in salted water according to its package and stir in half the butter.
Sauté garlic and shrimp in remaining butter until pink; finish with lemon and parsley and serve over polenta.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: Tender turkey meatballs and zucchini noodles in quick tomato sauce.
steps: Mix turkey, almond flour, egg, and seasoning; form small meatballs and brown in oil.
Add marinara and simmer until cooked through; quickly sauté zucchini noodles and serve with sauce.

recipes.title: Ginger Pork Lettuce Bowls
recipes.description: Ginger pork with tamari and scallions served in crisp lettuce.
steps: Cook pork in sesame oil until browned; drain excess fat.
Stir in tamari, ginger, and honey; spoon into lettuce and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Avocado Egg Salad Tomatoes
recipes.description: Creamy egg and avocado salad served in ripe tomato cups.
steps: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel, and chop.
Mash avocado with yogurt and mustard; fold in eggs and spoon into hollowed tomatoes.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato White Beans
recipes.description: White beans simmered in a creamy tomato sauce with basil.
steps: Warm garlic in olive oil, add passata, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in beans and cream; heat through and finish with basil and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Spicy Salmon Nori Hand Rolls
recipes.description: Sushi rice, salmon, and cucumber wrapped in crisp nori.
steps: Cook sushi rice according to its package and season lightly with rice vinegar.
Mix salmon with mayonnaise and sriracha; fill nori with rice, salmon, and cucumber and roll by hand.

recipes.title: Loaded Potato Skins
recipes.description: Crisp potato halves topped with cheddar, scallions, and yogurt.
steps: Microwave potatoes until tender, halve, brush with oil, and broil cut-side up until crisp.
Fill with cheddar to melt and top with scallions and yogurt.

recipes.title: Sesame Tofu Broccoli Rice
recipes.description: Crisp tofu and broccoli tossed with sesame and gluten-free tamari.
steps: Pan-crisp tofu in sesame oil; add broccoli and a splash of water and cover until tender.
Stir in tamari and honey; serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Quinoa Tabbouleh Bowl
recipes.description: Herby quinoa with cucumber, tomato, lemon, and grilled chicken.
steps: Cook quinoa and pan-sear seasoned chicken until cooked through.
Toss quinoa with cucumber, parsley, tomatoes, oil, and lemon; serve with sliced chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Chicken, peppers, and rice seasoned with lime and spices.
steps: Sear chicken in oil with cumin and paprika until nearly cooked.
Add peppers and cook until tender; fold in rice, warm through, and squeeze lime over the skillet.

recipes.title: Sardine Tomato Rice Cakes
recipes.description: Crisp rice cakes topped with sardines, tomato, and lemon.
steps: Mix rice with egg, form small patties, and pan-crisp in oil on both sides.
Top with sardines and tomato; season with pepper and lemon.

recipes.title: Turkey Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Large mushrooms filled with turkey, spinach, and Parmesan.
steps: Remove mushroom stems and brush caps with oil.
Brown turkey with garlic, fold in spinach and Parmesan, fill caps, and broil until mushrooms soften.

recipes.title: Maple Dijon Pork Chops with Apples
recipes.description: Pan-seared pork chops with apples and a tangy maple mustard glaze.
steps: Season pork and sear in oil until browned and cooked through; set aside.
Cook apple briefly, stir in mustard, maple, and broth, then return pork to coat.

recipes.title: Green Goddess Egg Bowl
recipes.description: Jammy eggs, greens, cucumber, and a quick herb yogurt dressing.
steps: Boil eggs for 7 minutes, cool, and peel.
Mix yogurt with herbs and lemon; arrange over greens with cucumber, avocado, and halved eggs.

recipes.title: Coconut Shrimp Mango Salad
recipes.description: Lime shrimp, ripe mango, and greens with a coconut-lime dressing.
steps: Season shrimp and cook in olive oil until pink.
Whisk coconut milk with lime juice; toss greens and mango with dressing and add shrimp.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata with Rice
recipes.description: Lemon-caper chicken served over rice without wheat flour.
steps: Season chicken and sear in oil until golden and cooked through; set aside.
Simmer broth, lemon, and capers in the pan; whisk in butter and parsley and serve over chicken and rice.

recipes.title: Lentil Taco Salad
recipes.description: Warm spiced lentils over crunchy lettuce with salsa and avocado.
steps: Warm lentils in oil with taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Arrange over lettuce and top with salsa, avocado, and cheddar.

recipes.title: Cod with Salsa Verde and Corn
recipes.description: Flaky cod with fresh herb salsa and sweet corn.
steps: Season cod and pan-sear in oil until opaque and flaky.
Chop parsley and capers with lemon juice and oil; serve over cod with warmed corn.

recipes.title: Blueberry Almond Overnight Oats
recipes.description: A make-ahead breakfast with certified gluten-free oats and blueberries.
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, and chia in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with blueberries and almond butter before eating.
